headline: Yum China Posts Better-Than-Expected Third-Quarter Profit
summary: Yum China reported third-quarter profit that beat consensus estimates, though its stock fell in premarket trading.
why: Yum China operates major fast-food restaurant chains across China, serving as a prominent barometer for discretionary consumer spending and retail trends in the region.

impacts.name: Yum China Holdings
impacts.why: Premarket share price declines reflect market reactions to the earnings report despite headline beats.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Earnings beats can be offset by forward guidance or broader market conditions, leading to premarket share price declines.
